name: Philips Park 5k
description: From Phillips Park run left down the road then cobbled path towards outwood trail. Then turn left to cross the bridge and take the right path after the bridge and follow the signs for the 13 bridge viaduct until you reach the irwell where we turn left again. Keep running until you get to a junction with four main routes , again turn left following the sign for Phillips Park. You should run very close to a pylon on your right and be next to a little lake  that is slightly above you. At this point carry straight on into the wooded section following the sign for Mere Clough where you should be running with a little stream on your right. Keep running until the end of this path where you will see a short uphill section to your left.  Take this and at the top take a small path left that will again take you across a bridge then turn left to return to the gate.
